description: 面向使用 AI 客服、销售智能体开展私域运营和客户转化的企业与商家。可在 WorkBuddy 中，通过自然语言查找、筛选和理解微信、企业微信、小红书、抖音等渠道中的真实客户，获取客户画像、历史沟通、兴趣偏好、购买意向和成交阶段，并执行单客户触达、批量营销、客户激活和精准跟进。客户回复后，可由 3Chat AI 客服/销售智能体继续自动接待、回答咨询、识别高意向客户、处理销售异议并推进成交，形成客户洞察、精准触达、AI 接待、持续跟进、成交转化的私域客户运营闭环。当前能力基于企业已接入 3Chat 的客户和渠道数据，不用于获取企业尚未拥有或未授权访问的外部用户数据。

display.description_en: Enables AI agents to operate private-domain customers across WeChat, RedNote, and Douyin. Find, filter, and understand real customers from these channels via natural language, including profiles, chat history, interests, purchase intent, and deal stage. Then run one-to-one outreach, batch marketing, reactivation, and precise follow-ups. Once customers reply, the 3Chat AI agent continues automatically by answering inquiries, spotting high-intent leads, handling objections, and supporting conversion. Based solely on the enterprise's own integrated customer and channel data, never external or unauthorized data.
